text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking a walk along the river one day
when...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I give up! I'm not catching anything!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. There's no need to get so
mad. Your
impatience is what's driving
them away.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Keep a firm grip and cool head, wait
patiently
and pretend you don't care if
you catch anything.
Then, before you
know it...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splish, splash!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: There. That's how you do it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Grrrrr... How do you make it look so
easy? There
must be more of a trick to
it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I want to catch one too! Ugh, I'm not
going to
give up! I won't, I won't!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... I'm not sure what else I can say to help... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you there. Can you spare some
advice for
this little miss here?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nothing she's been trying today is
working. I at
least want to make sure she
gets one bite.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good idea. Why don't we try a new
spot?
Some places work better for
certain people than
others.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean my first-rate skills will
be able to
catch enough fish to fill our
cooler to the gills at
the next spot?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sure. Just slow your roll, or else
you'll scare
off the fish again.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Asking for advice sure paid off, though.
Thanks
for the tip!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I later hear that Seiun Sky and King Halo
were
able to catch a huge haul.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho? You mean like how I pick up the
pace
during the middle leg of a race?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Race?! Are you truly letting me hear
about your
racing strategy?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Change of plans! I hereby
grant you
the honor of telling me all
about your strategies!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh my... How'd we get on this topic?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems that the art of fishing is
closely—and
unexpectedly—linked to
the art of racing.
